pattern.en: Enter the resource endpoint only, without deployments, chat/completions or api-version
pattern.zh: 只填资源地址，不要带 deployments、chat/completions 或 api-version

ui:help.en: Endpoint of the Azure OpenAI resource; requests go to <resource endpoint>/openai/v1/chat/completions, /responses and /embeddings. A trailing /openai/v1 or /openai is removed.
ui:help.zh: Azure OpenAI 资源的地址，请求发往 <资源地址>/openai/v1/chat/completions、/responses、/embeddings；末尾的 /openai/v1 或 /openai 会被去掉。

ui:help.en: Key of the resource, sent as api-key. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
ui:help.zh: 资源的 Key，以 api-key 发送；加密保存，保存后不再明文显示。
